hook: Want to make money online? *Start* with one number

lines: one number decides your whole plan

cta.text: The $1K Challenge walks you through it for 30 days. Link in bio.

altHook: The first number every new business needs

beats.text: Pick one thing to sell and its price.
Work out how many sales make $1,000.
Then how many views it takes to get those sales.

caption: The $1K Challenge walks you through your $1K plan for 30 days. Link in bio. Start with one product and its price, work backward to the number of sales that makes $1,000, then to the views it takes to get there. That number tells you how much content you actually need.

brief.source: $1K Club Playbook $1K Math (views → visitors → sales, worked backward from $1,000)
brief.reader: People who want to make money online and do not know where to start
brief.problem: They start posting without a goal number
brief.outcome: They work out their sales and views target first
brief.mainPoint: Work backward from $1,000 to sales to views
